```{r key_muts_analysis}
# Key Mutations Characterised in the Literature
if(nrow(resis_df)!=0){
  colnames(resis_df) <- gsub("ganciclovir", "Ganciclovir", colnames(resis_df))
  colnames(resis_df) <- gsub("foscarnet", "Foscarnet", colnames(resis_df))
  colnames(resis_df) <- gsub("cidofovir", "Cidofovir", colnames(resis_df))
  colnames(resis_df) <- gsub("maribavir", "Maribavir", colnames(resis_df))
  colnames(resis_df) <- gsub("letermovir", "Letermovir", colnames(resis_df))
  condensed_df <- resis_df |> 
    mutate(
      across(
        ends_with("EC50_ratio"),
        as.character
      )
    ) |> 
    pivot_longer(
      cols = matches("(_EC50_ratio|_resistance)$"),
      names_to = c("Drug", ".value"),
      names_pattern = "(.*)_(EC50_ratio|resistance)"
    ) |>
    filter(!(is.na(EC50_ratio) & is.na(resistance)))

  parse_ec50 <- function(x) {

    if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0)
      return(numeric())

    x <- trimws(as.character(x))
    x <- x[!is.na(x)]

    out <- numeric()

    for (v in x) {

      v_lower <- tolower(v)

      if (v_lower == "susceptible")
        next

      if (v_lower %in% c("resistance", "resistant"))
        next

      # Remove >, >=, <, <=
      v <- gsub("^[<>]=?", "", v)

      # Split values like 3.6/3.4 or 5.6\4.7
      vals <- unlist(strsplit(v, "[/\\\\]"))

      nums <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(vals))

      out <- c(out, nums[!is.na(nums)])
    }

    out
  }

  format_range <- function(x, digits = 1) {

    # If every non-NA value is "Susceptible"
    txt <- trimws(as.character(x))
    txt <- txt[!is.na(txt)]

    if (length(txt) > 0 &&
        all(tolower(txt) == "susceptible")) {
      return("Susceptible")
    }

    nums <- sort(parse_ec50(x))

    if (length(nums) == 0)
      return(NA_character_)

    if (min(nums) == max(nums))
      return(format(round(min(nums), digits), trim = TRUE))

    sprintf(
      "%s–%s",
      format(round(min(nums), digits), trim = TRUE),
      format(round(max(nums), digits), trim = TRUE)
    )
  }

  levels <- c("Susceptible", "Low", "Medium", "High")

  format_level <- function(x){

    x <- factor(na.omit(x), levels = levels, ordered = TRUE)

    if(length(x) == 0)
      return(NA_character_)

    lo <- min(x)
    hi <- max(x)

    if(lo == hi)
      as.character(lo)
    else
      paste0(lo, "–", hi)
  }

  get_resistance_level <- function(x) {

    case_when(
      is.na(x) ~ "Unknown",
      x < 2 ~ "Susceptible",
      x < 5 ~ "Low",
      x < 15 ~ "Medium",
      TRUE ~ "High"
    )
  }

  summarise_resistance <- function(x) {

    txt <- trimws(tolower(as.character(x)))
    txt <- txt[!is.na(txt)]

    if (length(txt) > 0) {

      if (all(txt == "susceptible"))
        return("Susceptible")

      if (all(txt %in% c("resistance", "resistant")))
        return("Unknown")
    }

    nums <- sort(parse_ec50(x))

    # No numeric values
    if (length(nums) == 0)
      return("Unknown")

    levs <- factor(
      get_resistance_level(nums),
      levels = c("Unknown", "Susceptible", "Low", "Medium", "High"),
      ordered = TRUE
    )

    lo <- min(levs)
    hi <- max(levs)

    if (lo == hi)
      as.character(lo)
    else
      paste0(lo, "–", hi)
  }

  summary_df <- condensed_df |>
    group_by(Gene, Mutation, Drug) |>
    summarise(
      `EC50 ratio` = format_range(EC50_ratio),
      `Level of resistance` = summarise_resistance(EC50_ratio),
      Reference = paste0("[@", unique(BIBTEXKEY), "]", collapse = "; "),#paste(unique(Reference), collapse = "; "),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}



```

```{r}
if(nrow(resis_df)!=0){
  level_order <- c(
    "Unknown",
    "Susceptible",
    "Low",
    "Medium",
    "High"
  )

  highest_level <- function(x) {

    if (is.na(x) || x == "")
      return("Unknown")

    # Split ranges like "Low–Medium"
    levs <- unlist(strsplit(x, "–"))

    levs <- factor(levs,
                  levels = level_order,
                  ordered = TRUE)

    as.character(max(levs))

  summary_table <- summary_df
```

```{r unknown_sig_analysis}
# Mutations of Unknown Significance
all_muts <- read_tsv(all_muts_file)
#This outputs only mutations found in the resistance genes if protocol is amplicon, or all genes if protocol is wgs.
if(protocol == "amplicon"){
  genes <- c("UL27", "UL51", "UL54", "UL56", "UL89", "UL97")
  all_muts <- anti_join(all_muts, resis_df, join_by("ANN[*].GENE" == "Gene", "AA_change" == "Mutation")) |> filter(`ANN[*].GENE` %in% genes) 
} else if(protocol == "wgs"){
  all_muts <- anti_join(all_muts, resis_df, join_by("ANN[*].GENE" == "Gene", "AA_change" == "Mutation"))
}

all_muts$`EFF[*].EFFECT` <- gsub("&", " & ", all_muts$`EFF[*].EFFECT`)

all_muts <- all_muts |> filter(`EFF[*].AA` != ".") |> rowwise() |> mutate(`Ref > Alt` = paste0(REF, " > ", ALT), Effect = `EFF[*].EFFECT`, Gene = `ANN[*].GENE`, Frequency = gsub(",", ", ", gsub("lofreq:|freebayes:|ivar:", "", `AF[*]`)), Depth = gsub(",", ", ", gsub("lofreq:|freebayes:|ivar:", "", `DP[*]`)), `Variant Callers` = gsub(",", ", ", detected_by)) |> select(POS, `Ref > Alt`, Gene, AA_change, Effect, Frequency, Depth, `Variant Callers`) |> arrange(POS)
```

```{r amr_cov_analysis}
# AMR Gene Coverage
muts <- read_tsv(bed_file, col_names = FALSE)
colnames(muts) <- c("Genome", "start", "end", "label")

plot_gene_coverage <- function(bam,
                               bed,
                               min_depth,
                               chrom,
                               start,
                               end,
                               gene_name = NULL) {

  # Create genomic range
  gr <- GRanges(
    seqnames = chrom,
    ranges = IRanges(start = start, end = end)
  )

  # Extract coverage
  cov <- coverage(
    BamFile(bam),
    param = ScanBamParam(which = gr)
  )

  # Convert to data frame
  depth_df <- data.frame(
    position = start:end,
    depth = as.numeric(cov[[chrom]][start:end]),
    Type = gene_name
  )

  # Get known AMR mutation positions to mark on plot
  bed <- bed |>
    filter(str_detect(label, gene_name)) |> 
    distinct(start, end, .keep_all = TRUE) |> 
    rowwise() |>
    mutate(
      depth = mean(
        as.numeric(
          cov[[chrom]][start:end]
        )
      ),
      coverage_status = ifelse(depth >= min_depth, "Sufficient", "Insufficient")
    ) |>
    ungroup()

  # Plot
  p <- ggplot(depth_df, aes(x = position, y = depth)) +
    geom_area(alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.3) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), panel.background = element_rect(fill = NA), axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.5), strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#94e4ca", colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5), strip.text = element_text(colour = "black", face = "bold")) +
    facet_grid(vars(Type)) +
    labs(x = "Genome Position", y = "Depth") + 
    geom_rect(data = bed, inherit.aes = FALSE, aes(xmin = start, xmax = end, ymin = 0, ymax = Inf, fill = coverage_status)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(Sufficient = "#A9A9A9", Insufficient = "red")) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, max(min_depth, max(depth_df$depth))))

  return(p)
}

if(protocol == "wgs"){
  cov <- coverage(BamFile(bam_file))
  header <- scanBamHeader(bam_file)
  chrom_lengths <- header[[1]]$targets
  depth_df <- data.frame(
      position = 1:chrom_lengths,
      depth = as.numeric(cov[[reference]][1:chrom_lengths])
  )

  depth_df$log_depth <- log(depth_df$depth)

  depth_df <- depth_df |> rowwise() |> mutate(log_depth = ifelse(log_depth == -Inf, 0, log_depth))
  gene_df <- data.frame(
    gene = c("UL27", "UL51", "UL54", "UL56", "UL89_B", "UL97"),
    start = c(as.numeric(unlist(str_split(ul27_pos, "-"))[1]), as.numeric(unlist(str_split(ul51_pos, "-"))[1]), as.numeric(unlist(str_split(ul54_pos, "-"))[1]), as.numeric(unlist(str_split(ul56_pos, "-"))[1]), as.numeric(unlist(str_split(ul89_pos, "-"))[1]), as.numeric(unlist(str_split(ul97_pos, "-"))[1])),
    end   = c(as.numeric(unlist(str_split(ul27_pos, "-"))[2]), as.numeric(unlist(str_split(ul51_pos, "-"))[2]), as.numeric(unlist(str_split(ul54_pos, "-"))[2]), as.numeric(unlist(str_split(ul56_pos, "-"))[2]), as.numeric(unlist(str_split(ul89_pos, "-"))[2]), as.numeric(unlist(str_split(ul97_pos, "-"))[2]))
  )

  gene_df$midpoint <- (gene_df$start + gene_df$end) / 2


  wgs_plot <- ggplot(depth_df, aes(position, log_depth)) +
    geom_area(alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.3) +
    labs(x = "Genome Position", y = "log Depth") +
    geom_rect(
        data = gene_df,
        aes(
            xmin = start,
            xmax = end,
            ymin = -Inf,
            ymax = Inf
        ),
        inherit.aes = FALSE,
        fill = "lightblue",
        alpha = 0.6
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    theme_classic() +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = gene_df, aes(x = midpoint, y = Inf, label = gene), inherit.aes = FALSE, segment.color = NA)
}
```

```{r insuff_analysis}
# table for AMR Gene Coverage

cov <- coverage(
    BamFile(bam_file)
  )
# Get known AMR mutation positions to mark on plot
muts <- muts |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    depth = mean(
      as.numeric(
        cov[[reference]][start:end]
      )
    ),
    coverage_status = ifelse(depth >= threshold, "Sufficient", "Insufficient")
  ) |>
  ungroup()

insufficient <- muts |> filter(coverage_status == "Insufficient")

if(nrow(insufficient) > 0){
  coverage_summary <- insufficient |>
  mutate(
    Gene = str_extract(label, "^[^_]+"),
    Codon = label |>
      str_remove("^[^_]+_") |>       # remove UL97_
      str_remove("^DEL") |>          # remove DEL
      str_remove("[A-Z*]$")      # remove final AA or stop codon
  ) |>
  group_by(Gene) |>
  summarise(
    `Codons below threshold` = n(),
    `Affected codons` = paste(Codon, collapse = ", "),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
}
```

# Summary

```{r summary_sent1}
sentence1 <- NULL
sentence2 <- NULL
sentence3 <- NULL
sentence4 <- NULL
sentence5 <- NULL

mutation_summary <- function(n, genes) {

  if(n == 0) {
    return("No resistance-associated mutations were detected across the assessed CMV resistance-associated genes.")
  }

  gene_text <- paste(genes, collapse = " and ")

  if(n == 1) {
    return(
      paste0(
        "One resistance-associated mutation was detected in the ",
        gene_text,
        " gene."
      )
    )
  }

  return(
    paste0(
      n,
      " resistance-associated mutations were detected across the ",
      gene_text,
      " genes."
    )
  )
}

if(nrow(resis_df)==0){
  n_muts <- 0
} else {
  n_muts <- length(tbl$`_data`$Mutation)
}

if(nrow(resis_df)==0){
  n_genes <- 0
} else {
  n_genes <- unique(tbl$`_data`$Gene)
}
sentence1 <- mutation_summary(n_muts, n_genes)
```

```{r summary_sent2to4}
if(nrow(resis_df)!=0){

  long_df <- summary_table |> pivot_longer(cols = 3:7, names_to = "Drug", values_to = "Level")

  high_level <- long_df |>
    filter(Level == "High")

  med_level <- long_df |>
    filter(Level == "Medium")

  low_level <- long_df |>
    filter(Level == "Low")

  if(nrow(high_level) > 0) {
    
    high_text <- paste0(
      high_level$Mutation,
      " (",
      high_level$Drug,
      ")",
      collapse = "; "
    )
    
    sentence2 <- paste0(
      "High-level resistance-associated findings included ",
      high_text,
      "."
    )
  }

  if(nrow(med_level) > 0) {
    
    med_text <- paste0(
      med_level$Mutation,
      " (",
      med_level$Drug,
      ")",
      collapse = "; "
    )
    
    sentence3 <- paste0(
      "Medium-level resistance-associated findings included ",
      med_text,
      "."
    )
  } 

  if(nrow(low_level) > 0) {
    
    low_text <- paste0(
      low_level$Mutation,
      " (",
      low_level$Drug,
      ")",
      collapse = "; "
    )
    
    sentence4 <- paste0(
      "Low-level resistance-associated findings included ",
      low_text,
      "."
    )
  }
}
```


```{r summary_sent5_print}
if(length(unique(insufficient$start)) > 0){
    n_genes <- length(unique(unlist(str_extract_all(insufficient$label, "UL\\d{2}"))))
    all_genes <- unique(unlist(str_extract_all(insufficient$label, "UL\\d{2}")))
    if(n_genes > 1){
      gene_list <- paste0(paste0(all_genes[1:length(all_genes)-1], collapse = ", "), " and ", all_genes[length(all_genes)])
    } else {
      gene_list <- all_genes
    }
    sentence5 <- paste0(
    "Coverage gaps (Section *AMR Gene Coverage* below) mean resistance loci in ", gene_list, " could not be fully assessed."
  )
}

summary_text <- paste(
  sentence1,
  sentence2,
  sentence3,
  sentence4,
  sentence5,
  sep = " "
)

```

# AMR Gene Coverage

Codons of known AMR mutations with insufficient sequencing coverage (below the depth threshold of **`r threshold`**) could not be assessed in this sample. In total **`r length(unique(insufficient$start))` codon positions** across six resistance genes fell below threshold. The figure and table below shows where resistance calls should be interpreted with caution due to coverage gaps.
